MOD_EDITOR_SEPARATE: Choose which installed mods load when running this project from Godot. Your launcher selection is separate.
MOD_EDITOR_RESTART: Saved choices apply after restarting the game. The current campaign keeps its loaded mods.
MOD_EDITOR_NEXT_CAMPAIGN: Changes apply the next time you open a campaign. No project files need editing.
